narrator.speaker: narrator
narrator.text: When your team is with a client, the next booking can still start with a conversation.

narrator.speaker: narrator
narrator.text: An AI assistant gathers the service request and customer details, then checks the configured schedule.

narrator.speaker: narrator
narrator.text: The booking workflow can create the appointment on the staff and master Google calendars.

narrator.speaker: narrator
narrator.text: SMS delivers the appointment details and the next step, such as a deposit link. A pending deposit is tracked separately from payment.

narrator.speaker: narrator
narrator.text: Your team sees the service, assigned staff member, appointment time, source and deposit status in one dashboard.

narrator.speaker: narrator
narrator.text: Requests that need a person can move to a human assistance or callback workflow.

narrator.speaker: narrator
narrator.text: This is a fictional walkthrough. Let's map the workflow for your business.
